home_net.description: The internal network definition; traffic from/to this is treated as HOME_NET.

external_net.description: External network definition; typically set to 'any' or specific CIDR ranges.

oracle_ports.description: Port number(s) for Oracle database traffic.

update_rules_url.description: URL to fetch updated Snort rules from.

avg_ip_header_len.description: Average IP header length (in bytes) for dsize emulation.

avg_tcp_header_len.description: Average TCP header length (in bytes) for dsize emulation.

max_frame_len.description: Maximum frame length (MTU) for iptables length match.

max_string_len.description: Maximum string length for iptables --string/--hex-string matches.

whitelist.description: Comma-separated list of IPs/networks to ignore (whitelist).

fwsnort_input_jump.description: Jump position in INPUT chain to insert FWSNORT_INPUT chain.

fwsnort_output_jump.description: Jump position in OUTPUT chain to insert FWSNORT_OUTPUT chain.

fwsnort_forward_jump.description: Jump position in FORWARD chain to insert FWSNORT_FORWARD chain.
